title: `title`
description: A human friendly display name for the tool. Presentational, not a safety signal.
question: Is the tool title annotation present at each capture boundary?
notes: Mixed across the 2 adapters that reach 2026-07-28; 3 cannot reach the revision.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI 1.15.1 requires MCP Python SDK 1.26.x, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.2: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2 requires mcp<2.0.0, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.3: OpenAI Agents SDK: retained as FunctionTool._mcp_title, outside the declared FunctionTool fields.
notes_by_num.4: Pydantic AI: retained in ToolDefinition.metadata['annotations']; not part of parameters_json_schema.
notes_by_num.5: Mastra 1.17.3 negotiated MCP 2025-11-25. The scanner refused to compare that capture with a 2026-07-28 source.

verdict.headline: Mixed across the 2 adapters that reach 2026-07-28; 3 cannot reach the revision.
verdict.detail: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 and Pydantic AI 2.40.0 change it or retain it elsewhere. CrewAI, LangChain and Mastra cannot negotiate MCP 2026-07-28, so they reach none of it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Low stakes. Included for completeness rather than concern.
